troubleshooting.title: A report shows "Access is denied"
troubleshooting.shortdesc: You open a report in Acme Console and see "Access is denied" in place of the report.

cause.title: Why it happens
cause.p: Your account has the Viewer role in the workspace that owns the report. A viewer can open dashboards, but not the reports behind them.

step.cmd: Open the workspace that owns the report.
Select Members, and then find your name.
Ask a workspace owner to change your role to Analyst.

ul.li: Sign out, and then sign in again. A role change applies at the next sign-in.
If the message stays, send the report's address and the time of the error to the service desk.
